text:
Ravi Patel: Quick backyard wildlife update — my three ducklings apparently learned fetch overnight. Dropped a short clip and a couple of stills. They bring the little foam ball back like tiny, soggy retrievers. 🦆🎾 https://imgur.com/a/ducklings (clip: duck_fetch_01.mp4)
Ava Li: no way. that is the wholesome content i needed today. :heart_eyes:
Jordan Kim: WAIT they actually bring it back?? or just run in circles and hope someone throws it again? 😂
Ravi Patel: They actually bring it back. Two-step ritual: waddle > grab > sprint > dramatic flop. I can upload more clips if people want.
Priya S.: please more. also: what are their names??
Ravi Patel: Names: Pancake, Mango, and Little Leaf. yes those are real. sample caption idea: "Pancake demands encore."
Jordan Kim: Pancake = instant stan. adding Pancake to my phone background.
Ava Li: Mango looks like they judge my sandwich choices.
Priya S.: Little Leaf is already an influencer. I'm expecting a merch collab. :sparkles:
files-bot: Uploaded "duck_fetch_01.mp4" (3.2 MB)
Ravi Patel: Uploaded a slo-mo of the dramatic flop. Warning: contains excessive tail-rump wiggle.
Jordan Kim: Observational note: ducks make fetch look like a startup pivot.
Ava Li: Can we have a poll — cutest move? 1) Pancake flop 2) Mango side-eye 3) Little Leaf sprint
Priya S.: 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ (all of the above)
Ravi Patel: Poll results: unanimous. Also, neighborhood toddler now insists on daily fetch sessions. Sorry neighbors.
Jordan Kim: This thread cured my meeting-induced gloom. thank you. :raised_hands:
Ava Li: Petition to make "Duck Breaks" an official company ritual every Friday.
Priya S.: seconded. mandatory screensaver rotation.
Ravi Patel: Happy to volunteer my backyard as the venue, pending city permit. kidding. mostly. :sweat_smile:
Jordan Kim: If Pancake ever gets a LinkedIn, I will endorse their soft skills.
Ava Li: uploaded a gif reaction :duck: (reacted with :heart:)
